answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore-registered identity and commits to an epoch polynomial, whose evaluations support rate-limit proofs and nullifiers. One valid message hides the identity secret; a second within the same quota scope exposes a distinct Shamir share, enabling interpolation and proof of duplicate use. The protocol can then slash the bond without delay. Thus an orchard of identities cannot multiply influence: each echo risks collateral, while the ocean of honest messages remains private.
